scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:check && docker compose up -d --build postgres api web
scripts.docker:host: npm run docker:check && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.host-network.yml up -d --build postgres api web
